entries.zh: 拜；礼节性拜会，行礼致候之拜访
entries.en: to pay a courtesy visit; to make one's compliments

entries.zh: 吊丧；吊唁亡者亲属以致哀
entries.en: to condole; to visit the relatives of the deceased
entries.notes: M 栏声母有 [疑:f/t]（当为 t，吊 tiau），义据汉字「吊」与西语互证。

entries.zh: 查；查察、核验
entries.en: to examine, to inspect (as the poxquido does)
entries.notes: 西语比较对象 poxquido 指称未详（疑为某职官或人物称谓），不影响「查察」本义，故仍记高置信。

entries.zh: 暗访；秘密查访
entries.en: to visit in secret; to investigate covertly

entries.zh: 勘验；实地查验（如教长巡视考阅那样查验）
entries.en: to inspect and examine, as a prelate on visitation

entries.zh: 到访；（帝王尊长出于恩眷之）临幸、驾临
entries.en: to visit ordinarily, out of goodwill; (of a sovereign or superior) to grace with a visit

entries.zh: 拜访；一般随意走访
entries.en: to visit, to pay a call

entries.zh: 拜探；探望问安式的拜访
entries.en: to call on and inquire after someone
entries.notes: M 栏有 T99 污损（音标符号一处），字面「拜探」与西语互证清晰，按规约置信降为低。

entries.zh: 朝参；百官上朝参拜皇帝（常朝参见）
entries.en: to attend the imperial court; to pay court to the sovereign
entries.notes: M 栏声母有 [疑:f/t]（当为 t，朝 tiau），义据汉字「朝參」与西语互证。

entries.zh: 朝见；入朝觐见皇帝
entries.en: to have audience with the sovereign; to pay court
entries.notes: M 栏声母有 [疑:f/t]，义据汉字「朝見」与西语互证。

entries.zh: 拜正；新正贺岁之拜（犹拜年）
entries.en: to pay New Year courtesy calls; to present the New Year greetings
entries.notes: 西语 buendang 名目未详（或为闽南语借词，或为 buenos días 之讹写），M 栏有 T99 污损；拜正之义据汉字与 M 音互证。

entries.zh: 拜圣寿；皇帝寿辰之朝贺
entries.en: to pay respects to the sovereign on his birthday (imperial birthday greetings)
entries.notes: M 栏有 T99 污损；圣寿＝皇帝寿辰，与西语 cumplecimientos（寿辰）互证，按规约置信降为低。

entries.zh: 官员朝拜君王；原文作「拜東」，疑为「拜冬」（冬至朝贺）之形讹
entries.en: (of mandarins) to pay respects to the sovereign; probably the winter-solstice court congratulation (baidong)
entries.notes: H 栏作「拜東」而 M 音 tang 与「冬」同，结合本页拜正、拜圣寿诸条疑为「拜冬」，属推断故降中置信。

entries.zh: 兵巡道；明代职司兵备巡查之官，巡视军伍
entries.en: bingxundao, the Ming circuit intendant of military affairs (inspector of the troops)

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 西语 fuesc 与汉字「雷脚暈」无法互证，M 栏声母存 [疑] 且两处 T99 污损，语义无法定夺（推测为探监查狱之类，不足据）。

entries.zh: 探问；走访问候、探询音讯
entries.en: to inquire after someone; to visit asking for news of him

entries.zh: 吊纸；吊祭亡者并致哀悼颂扬之文纸
entries.en: to condole the dead with courtesies, sending a paper of praise (condolence note)
entries.notes: M 栏声母有 [疑:f/t]；西语 q̃＝que，xalabanza 疑即 alabanza（颂词），展开依赖推断。

entries.zh: 省病；省视问疾，探望病人
entries.en: to visit the sick; to inquire after a patient
entries.notes: M 栏长串污损（八处 T99）、R 栏有 [疑:d/l/x]，本义据西语与汉字「省病」互证，按规约置信降为低。

entries.zh: 参见；拜见尊长上司
entries.en: to pay respects to a superior; to have an audience with him
entries.notes: 西语 sup. 缩写展开依赖推断（疑 superior），M 栏有两处 T99 污损；参见之义据汉字与 M 音互证。

entries.zh: 查验；查核检验
entries.en: to inspect and examine

entries.zh: 查勘；巡视查勘所辖地方
entries.en: to survey and inspect one's district

entries.zh: 巡按；御史奉差巡历地方、纠察官吏
entries.en: xun'an, the circuit-inspecting censor; to tour and make rounds of inspection
entries.notes: 西语 cap- 缩写展开未定且 rondar 有 [疑:w/u]，M 栏声母有 [疑:f/t]；巡按之义据汉字与 M 音互证。
